description: Separates 'the requested locale has a catalog but not this key' from 'the requested locale has no catalog at all'. Only pl and en are loaded; ru and ar are requested and never loaded, so localeFallbackCandidates yields a candidate whose localizedStrings map is null and the Polish fallback locale supplies. The distinction matters because an implementation could plausibly consult the donor's rules only when it had a catalog to skip, and default to the requested locale otherwise. Verified against the oracle: attemptedLocales is ['ru','pl'] / ['ar','pl'] and resolvedLocale is pl.
